t: The LAP Chaac tilt fire rated LED downlights are a versatile lighting solution for various indoor applications. These 5.5W integrated LED downlights offer 600 lumens and feature a stylish brushed nickel bezel. They are fire rated for 30, 60, and 90 minutes, providing enhanced safety for installations in new builds and renovations. With an IP65 rating, they are suitable for bathroom zone 2, as well as kitchens and other damp areas. The colour temperature is adjustable between 2700K warm white, 4000K cool white, and 6000K daylight, allowing customisation for different moods and tasks. They are also dimmable and have a tilt function for directional lighting.
b: Tilt Feature Directs Light Where Needed
